title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: monthly dues rate and bundled membership discount by tier
content:
This document covers the Corporate Wellness Partnership's recurring per-employee dues rate billed to the employer, and the discount that rate bundles onto the enrolled employee's own club membership dues.

| Tier | Recurring monthly dues per enrolled employee | Employer-sponsored discount off the employee's bundled club membership dues | May this discount stack with another membership promotion | Combined discount cap when stacking is allowed |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Startup Partner | $22.00 | 10% | No | 10% |
| Small Business Partner | $19.00 | 15% | No | 15% |
| Mid-Market Partner | $16.00 | 20% | Yes | 25% |
| Enterprise Partner | $13.00 | 25% | Yes | 30% |
| Municipal Partner | $15.00 | 20% | Yes | 20% |
| Nonprofit Partner | $14.00 | 25% | Yes | 25% |

Where stacking is not allowed for a tier, the employer-sponsored discount applies on its own and is not combined with another membership promotion. Where stacking is allowed, the combined discount percentage across the employer-sponsored discount and any other membership promotion may not exceed that tier's combined discount cap.
